summary: The public AArch64 NEON modules incorrectly required the aarch64_neon Cargo feature even when target_feature="neon" enabled the underlying implementation on Rust 1.61+. The fix exposes those modules when either feature is present. The implementation reversal below is exact and unique. Blocked under the confirmation gate: existing tests simple_valid and test_neon_chunked_panic reference the missing module, but reversing the fix on the affected configuration causes compilation failure rather than an executed test failure. Other configurations do not expose the bug. No eligible runtime-detecting test was found; no builds or tests were run.
